annotations.title: Calculate VantageScore 4.0 vs Classic FICO & LO Credit Cost Savings

description: Models 2026 Homebuyer VantageScore 4.0 vs Classic FICO 2/4/5 and consumer app VantageScore 3.0 (24-month trended utilization, medical/paid collection exclusions, 1-month thin-file scoring, 14-day inquiry window, and State HFA overlays) plus Loan Officer 45% Equifax VantageScore 4.0 credit report cost savings and 65% fallout conversion ROI.

inputSchema.description: Inputs for deterministic 2026 VantageScore 4.0 vs Classic FICO 2/4/5 homebuyer simulation and Loan Officer credit report cost + 65% fallout conversion ROI.

appVantageScore3.description: Consumer app VantageScore 3.0 baseline score (for example Credit Karma or Chase Credit Journey, 300 to 850).

avgLoanAmount.description: Loan Officer mode: average funded mortgage loan amount in USD.

baselineCloseRatePct.description: Loan Officer mode: baseline pull-through close percentage (2026 industry benchmark: 35% close / 65% fallout).

collectionsProfile.description: Collection account profile (VantageScore 4.0 ignores 100% of medical and $0-balance paid collections).

creditHistoryAge.description: Oldest active credit tradeline age: 1-5 months (scorable on VS 4.0, unscorable on Classic FICO), 6-23 months, or 24+ months.

inquiryWindow.description: Mortgage rate-shopping hard inquiry clustering (VantageScore 4.0 deduplicates within 14 days vs 45 days on Classic FICO).

jointBorrowerSharePct.description: Loan Officer mode: percentage of applications with a co-borrower (0 to 100).

mode.description: Simulation mode: homebuyer (VantageScore 4.0 vs Classic FICO 2/4/5 vs consumer VS 3.0), loan_officer (branch credit report cost savings & 65% fallout conversion ROI), or both.

monthlyApplications.description: Loan Officer mode: monthly mortgage applications originated by LO or branch.

netOriginatorBps.description: Loan Officer mode: net originator/branch revenue in basis points (100 bps = 1.00%).

rentUtilityHistory.description: On-file rent, utility (NCTUE), and telecom payment reporting status.

resellerMarkupPerBureau.description: Loan Officer mode: credit reseller verification/platform fee per bureau in USD.

targetStateKey.description: Optional target State HFA overlay preset to test against Classic FICO floors.

trendedUtilization.description: 24-month trended revolving credit card utilization trajectory evaluated by VantageScore 4.0.

uqualFalloutRecapturePct.description: Loan Officer mode: percentage of fallout applicants recaptured via 60-to-90-day UQUAL 4-Pillar readiness.

name: calculate_vantagescore_4_impact
title: Calculate VantageScore 4.0 vs Classic FICO & LO Credit Cost Savings
